name: Pallant
title: New Elarite Titan Pallant

max_level.notes: This Titan is at the maximum level.

description: Pallant is an Elarite and Earth tank built for Earth Titan teams. His ultimate knocks back the nearest enemy and turns their movement into area damage against enemies in the path.

skills.name: Elarite Ram
skills.description: Attacks the nearest enemy and knocks them back. While in motion, the opponent deals damage to all enemies in their path.

artifacts.name: Zorval's Grimoire
artifacts.description: When a titan uses the Elarite Ram skill in combat, it can trigger an effect that gives bonus weapon artifact stats to the whole team for 9 seconds.

artifacts.name: Elarite Crown
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite crown artifact shared among Elarite-class titans.

artifacts.name: Chthonic Defense Seal
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite seal artifact shared among Elarite-class titans.

best_teams.name: Earth Elarite Core
best_teams.notes: Earth team with Pallant as the Elarite tank. Tested at max level and performed very well against mirrored Earth compositions.

best_teams.name: Darkness Counter Test
best_teams.notes: Tested against Tenebris, Keros, Umbra, Mort, and Brustar at max level.

best_teams.name: Elarite Mixed Core
best_teams.notes: Early Elarite core with Pallant as tank, Alecto as killer, and Orm as support. Add two super titans such as Tenebris, Araji, Eden, Solaris, or Hyperion until more Elarite titans arrive.

team_member_notes.Pallant: Elarite and Earth tank with knockback control.
team_member_notes.Verdoc: Earth titan used in current Earth team cores.
team_member_notes.Eden: Earth super titan with strong control and burst.
team_member_notes.Sylva: Earth titan used in current Earth team cores.

lore: Pallant brings Elarite power to Earth Titan teams, giving them a front-line tank who can disrupt enemy positioning with Elarite Ram.

notes: Pallant has two elements: Elarite and Earth.
His Elarite Ram skill deals knockback damage and collision damage based on Physical Attack.
He gives Earth teams a new Elarite tank option and helps form the early Elarite core with Alecto and Orm.

nota_pvp.resumo: Testes feitos em nivel maximo indicam que Pallant fortalece muito os times de Terra.
nota_pvp.conclusao: Nos meus testes o time eden, verdoc, avalon, angus, pallant, foi a melhor combinacao para times de terra no evento de rixo que reune os todos titans no nivel maximo, esse time foi o que se saiu melhor na defesa e o que mais venceu no ataque. Os times de Terra estao entre os mais fortes da atualidade. Pallant deve brilhar muito em times de Terra, principalmente contra times de Agua. Como ja existem Pallant, Alecto e Orm, tambem ja da para montar um nucleo Elarite com dois aliados super titans ate chegarem novos Elarites.
